name: BrainAurora Medical Technology Limited
summary: BrainAurora Medical Technology Limited provides system integral software solutions for hospitals and research projects in Mainland China. The company develops medical-grade digital therapy (DTx) products for cognitive impairment. It offers the evaluation and intervention of cognitive impairments to treat vascular diseases, neurodegenerative diseases, psychiatric disorders, and child development deficiencies.
